note: Frozen snapshot of the Twitter sidebar as it stood when the trip ended in 2012. No dates exist in the source.

updates.author: paul
updates.text: Afar Magazine interviewed us about our trip in the Jul/Aug issue. Check it out on the newsstands or [see it here](http://www.afar.com/afar/little-house-on-the-highway)!

updates.author: alana
updates.text: it feels weird to be putting our house (ok, fine, our rv.) in storage today. also weird? showering without flip flops. and dishwashers!

updates.author: alana
updates.text: totally forgot how good sonoma county smells on a hot day. oak trees, grass, and blackberry bushes. if you live here, you know what i mean.

updates.author: paul
updates.text: Just filled the tanks on the RV with gas for the last time on this trip. 1712 gallons of gas in 9 months.

updates.author: paul
updates.text: Back in California for the first time since January. And hwy 199 is one of the best driving roads of the whole trip. Good to be home.

updates.author: alana
updates.text: sitting in the coach with the heater on. summer on the coast.

updates.author: alana
updates.text: I've always lived within a half hour from the ocean, but today was the first time I've seen a whale in oh, at least 20 years!

updates.author: alana
updates.text: we just passed our 8th car! that was built in 1915.

updates.author: paul
updates.text: We missed our chance to drive through a town called Idiotville in Oregon today.

updates.author: paul
updates.text: Went to Cape Flattery today, the northwestern-most point of Washington and saw a bunch of puffins.

updates.author: alana
updates.text: going into town (forks) later to take pictures of all the hilarious twilight related stuff. they basically rebranded the whole area!

updates.author: alana
updates.text: camping next to the pacific ocean, which we haven't seen since the first week of january. it's foggy, of course.

updates.author: paul
updates.text: Saw our 8th SR-71 today at the awesome Museum of Flight in Seattle. We are now more than a 3rd of the way to seeing all of the remaining 20.

updates.author: alana
updates.text: in olympia for a night, then off to olympic national park for 4 more. I predict it'll be rainy!

updates.author: alana
updates.text: the Seattle food scene beat Portland in sunset mag, but will it be able to top the last 3 days? seems doubtful, but we'll give it a try!

updates.author: alana
updates.text: Portland has amazing food! today we had food truck BBQ chicken, a strawberry/ blackberry galette from ken's and deep fried kimchi at biwa.

updates.author: paul
updates.text: Having millions of Cajun tots and beers at the Kennedy School in Portland.

updates.author: paul
updates.text: Had the charcoal grilled boar at Pok Pok in Portland tonight. Highly recommended.

updates.author: paul
updates.text: The timberline lodge on Mt Hood (the exterior from the Shining) might have the most amazing interior of any lodge I have been to.

updates.author: paul
updates.text: Just passed a Church of God in Zillah Washington.

updates.author: alana
updates.text: its really hot and we just drove past an amazingly delicious smelling field of mint. now I really want a mint julep.

updates.author: paul
updates.text: Going to see a sweet laser show (with a Vangelis soundtrack) projected on the Grand Coulee Dam in a little bit.

updates.author: paul
updates.text: Back in the PST. IdaHOLLA!

updates.author: alana
updates.text: s'mores, campfire, and the smell of weed wafting over the campground.

updates.author: alana
updates.text: saw a moose on the side of the road on our drive home tonight. he was just standing there, being a giant moose.

updates.author: paul
updates.text: I would like to give a solemn thank you to the many bugs that gave their lives on our windshield today so that we could get to Glacier NP.

updates.author: alana
updates.text: we just passed a car. that makes 7 since the beginning of the trip.

updates.author: alana
updates.text: we can see snow capped mountains for the first time since we were in tucson back in january.

updates.author: paul
updates.text: Little Bighorn Battlefield was a nice stopover. Hell of a beautiful place to have a war.

updates.author: paul
updates.text: So long South Dakota, you treated us right. Your turn Wyoming.

updates.author: alana
updates.text: jerk chicken on the BBQ, beer in hand, sounds of ice cream vans and kids playing in the campground creek. yep, feels like summer.

updates.author: paul
updates.text: Went to Deadwood today, saw Seth Bullock, Wild Bill and Calamity Jane's graves and visited George Hearst's massive open-pit Homestake mine

updates.author: paul
updates.text: Many people have said Mt Rushmore wasn't really worth seeing, not having been since I was a kid. But I found it both ridiculous and awesome.

updates.author: alana
updates.text: gretchen saw her first buffalo today, and then she barked at it. the buffalo was unimpressed.

updates.author: paul
updates.text: The western prairie of South Dakota is stunning. I have missed the west more than I thought and am now soaking this up.

updates.author: paul
updates.text: Visited the Corn Palace in Mitchell South Dakota today. Looked like someone made a model of Moscow's St. Basil's Cathedral for a state fair.

updates.author: alana
updates.text: I have never seen rain like we saw today, it was somewhere close to 4" in about an hour. it was like being in a little hurricane.

updates.author: paul
updates.text: Saw our 6th SR71 today at the strategic air command museum in nebraska. There are only 20 left so we are well on the way to seeing them all

updates.author: paul
updates.text: Got 40 great records for less than $100 at the amazing Love Garden Vinyl in Lawrence Kansas

updates.author: alana
updates.text: lots of detours already due to flooding up north. more to come, I'm sure.

updates.author: alana
updates.text: I think this little storm in Lawrence KS has the loudest thunder I've ever heard. it really sounds fake, like its from a movie.

updates.author: paul
updates.text: Oklahoma has the best slogan of any state: Oklahoma is OK

updates.author: paul
updates.text: Seeing the suitcase that killed Tom Mix at the Tom Mix museum in Dewey Oklahoma

updates.author: alana
updates.text: the weather today started out super hot, then turned humid, then turned into possible tornados then lots of rain. and lightning. oh, Kansas.

updates.author: alana
updates.text: tonight the dog and I saw fireflies for the first time. (the dog barked.)

updates.author: paul
updates.text: At Clinton lake state park in Lawrence Kansas. Perfect summer weather and light. Grilling and drinking outside. Thanks Kansas.

updates.author: paul
updates.text: Man, 25mph crosswinds in an RV with gusts of up to 40 sucks. My arms are very tired tonight.

updates.author: alana
updates.text: they turn over 1/2 a million cases a day, at this one plant! 5 football fields worth, 18 feet high, every 24 hours. insane!

updates.author: alana
updates.text: did the Miller tour today in Milwaukee, as it turns out, Americans drink a lot of beer.

updates.author: paul
updates.text: Touring Frank Lloyd Wright's incredible Johnson Wax Headquarters buildings. Such amazing details.

updates.author: paul
updates.text: Went to The Violet Hour in Chicago with Dinesh and Shawn last night, and happy to say that the place lived up to its rep for good cocktails.

updates.author: paul
updates.text: Camped on the shore of lake michigan tonight. Surprisingly crystalline blue water

updates.author: paul
updates.text: Drove on interstate 80 today. It charged us a toll. I thought we were friends i80

updates.author: paul
updates.text: Hello Chicago. See you tomorrow for the rest of the week.

updates.author: alana
updates.text: our neighbors tonight have chased away the same raccoon 4 times already. clearly they are having something delicious for dinner.

updates.author: paul
updates.text: Missing New Orleans tonight. Making up a pot of dirty rice and a batch of sazeracs.

updates.author: alana
updates.text: our security system, aka our crappy paint job, looks fine until it's parked next to a gmc with a good paint job, or a new $500k rv.

updates.author: alana
updates.text: the Mississippi river is twice as wide as it is on the gps's map. but it looks like it's dropped at least 4 feet.

updates.author: alana
updates.text: we just drove through Future City, Illinois. not very futuristic.

updates.author: paul
updates.text: Got the Miata all sorted out and running again. Good to have our shuttlecraft back.

updates.author: alana
updates.text: how do we know when to move on to somewhere else? when I finally figure out how to navigate without a map.

updates.author: alana
updates.text: somehow managed to attend two events in Kentucky in a week where the Governor was doing a ribbon cutting. random.

updates.author: alana
updates.text: our visiting bay area friends brought the bay area's weather with them. cold and rainy, which is better than 90 degrees with 65% humidity!

updates.author: paul
updates.text: The hard hat tour at buffalo trace distillery was great. Got to taste the mash and get up close to the still.

updates.author: paul
updates.text: Went to a fried chicken place tonight for dinner that had KOOL-AID on the drinks menu.

updates.author: paul
updates.text: Makers Mark, Heaven Hill and Jim Beam distilleries today. Makers was beautiful and actually the best tour so far.

updates.author: paul
updates.text: Dang... blew the radiator in the Miata today. Good thing it is easy to hook it up to the RV to tow it along behind us.

updates.author: paul
updates.text: Just passed the ham and gun store. We're totally going back there tomorrow.

updates.author: alana
updates.text: adult bookstore on one side of the freeway, and a billboard on the other side that says "hell is real."

updates.author: alana
updates.text: so far I've been to 11 new states on this trip. yesterday we added Kentucky to the list.

updates.author: paul
updates.text: Man, they don't screw around at Princes Hot Chicken Shack in Nashville. Medium hot fried chicken is almost too spicy for me.

updates.author: paul
updates.text: Great drinks and superb bartendership at Bar 308 in Nashville. Thanks Ben and Brandon!

updates.author: paul
updates.text: At Hatch Show Print in Nashville, picking up some great letterpress posters for friends.

updates.author: alana
updates.text: if you ever need to teach a class in advanced freeway tailgating, talk to someone from Memphis.

updates.author: paul
updates.text: At the stax soul music museum. So much good music came from here.

updates.author: paul
updates.text: Survived 4 tornados within 10 miles of us, got the RV stuck in mud, and drove through 10 in of water, but we finally made it to Graceland.

updates.author: paul
updates.text: Drove within 9 miles of a tornado today. Had to break our streak and get a hotel room for the first time. Tornados are annoying.

updates.author: alana
updates.text: vuvuzela like sound coming from the direction of the lake tonight. frogs?

updates.author: paul
updates.text: This week: a tow truck museum, 3 distilleries, tour of the place that makes Ssäm's country ham and a glass boat tour of an underground lake

updates.author: alana
updates.text: I think waffle house and dollar general should merge, easier distribution to every town in the south. plus both have black & yellow signs.

updates.author: alana
updates.text: heading west again feels weird. it's been a while.

updates.author: paul
updates.text: Great Smokey Mountain National Park was predictably amazing. Highly recommended in spring, so, so green.

updates.author: paul
updates.text: Bummed that Tennessee's state motto isn't actually "Tennesseein is Tennebeleivin!"

updates.author: paul
updates.text: I love that in all of the 19th century graffiti we have seen on this trip, the artists always took the time to add serifs to their letters.

updates.author: paul
updates.text: Heading to the Foxfire Museum now. A book series that was on every 1970s bookshelf containing Appalachian wisdom on how to do everything .

updates.author: paul
updates.text: Just had a great week in Atlanta with our hosts Josh, Katy, Lucy and little Beatrice. Thanks guys!

updates.author: paul
updates.text: Atlanta is more pretty then i remembered. Hilly and windy roads and billions of trees.

updates.author: paul
updates.text: Went to stone mountain today. Its like the confederate mt rushmore.

updates.author: alana
updates.text: Having a cocktail at Holman and Finch in Atlanta that tastes like soap...in a good way. I blame the rhubarb bitters.

updates.author: paul
updates.text: At the Cyclorama in Atlanta. A rotating football field sized painting and diorama depicting the battle of Atlanta. Super-kitch.

updates.author: alana
updates.text: Georgia needs some of those wildlife overpasses like they have in Florida for armadillos.

updates.author: alana
updates.text: it appears spring break has finally (finally!) ended. the 1000 acre park we are in has just one other set of campers.

updates.author: alana
updates.text: bought a book in charleston today, "barbecue road trip." now I'm really looking forward to Memphis and Kansas city.

updates.author: paul
updates.text: Went to an extraordinary bar in Charleston last night, The Gin Joint. Best Chartreuse Swizzle I've ever had, and tobacco infused Manhattans!

updates.author: paul
updates.text: Made it to Fort Sumter where the civil war (aka the war of northern aggression) began 150 years ago this weekend.

updates.author: paul
updates.text: At a bar, husk, in charleston, that has 9 kinds of pappy van winkle bourbons! We're getting close to the source.

updates.author: alana
updates.text: on the move again, on our way to spend 3 days in charleston.

updates.author: alana
updates.text: bought a tobacco and honey scented soap in savannah today. the rv smells really good now. might go back and buy the whole line.

updates.author: alana
updates.text: heading into georgia today and crossing off another state from my haven't visited list.

updates.author: paul
updates.text: We finally caught the mouse that has been chewing through our walls since Louisiana. We don't have to keep the cereal in the shower anymore.

updates.author: alana
updates.text: we bought stuff to grill, but then we drove past a BBQ place that smelled really good. so we had that instead. oh, the perils of the south.

updates.author: paul
updates.text: Saw space shuttle endeavor on the launch pad for the last time. A bummer the shuttle program is ending but I'm excited for what comes next.

updates.author: paul
updates.text: We are seeing a good diversity of eagles painted on RVs. Soaring over buffalo, keeping watch for freedom, even eagles that fade into flames.

updates.author: paul
updates.text: Got a new radiator for the RV. We are now running about 30 degrees cooler. Just in time too, it's 90 outside right now.

updates.author: paul
updates.text: There are cardinals attacking our shiny aluminum wheels. Cool looking birds, but not so bright. I wish they would go after our mouse.

updates.author: paul
updates.text: Our kitchen table is made of unfinished oak and my very hot laptop is sitting on it. It really smells like bourbon in here.

updates.author: paul
updates.text: Woke up yesterday to the sound of the blue angels training. Found out we were camped 2 miles from their home runway in Pensacola.

updates.author: paul
updates.text: Fried alligator at cochon in new orleans is the business. You should go to there.

updates.author: paul
updates.text: At cafe du monde. There is so much powdered sugar on the ground, it looks like Tony Montana's study.

updates.author: paul
updates.text: Triple milestone today: we crossed the mississippi river, turned over 4000 miles and have now spent 60 days on the road.

updates.author: paul
updates.text: Heading to a big lebowski quote-off at the Alamo draft house in Austin and then to the highball for white russians and bowling.

updates.author: paul
updates.text: West Texas is great... just saw some cowboys in a helicopter land at the store next to us (in the middle of nowhere) for a beer run.

updates.author: paul
updates.text: I take back some of the mean things I have said about west Texas... The drive through Guadalupe national park at sunset was exquisite.
